selection: For each budget/preference choose feature group and training window using validation utility only; tie-break by case name. Preserve every validation candidate. Matched discount-zero uses identical selected features/window. Fixed controls retain the prior study's execution and risk rules.
explainability: Exact chosen-minus-runner-up Q decomposition into standardized feature contributions, one-period reward and continuation; same-state feature-median action probes; actual actions and subsequent net outcomes. Explanations describe model scores, not causal effects or proof of timing skill.
scope: Prospective follow-up specification recorded before fitting this study. These historical dates and retained source strategies were previously researched. Fractional strategy-index allocation, not joint integer-contract admission.
